items: Restaurant operations software brings scheduling, inventory, food costs, tasks and compliance into one system, which makes daily management simpler.
If you run more than one site, look for a single dashboard that rolls up data across locations and lets you compare performance location by location.
Prioritize automation of repetitive work like demand forecasts, prep lists and reorder alerts, plus integrations with your POS, payroll and accounting systems.
Check ease of use and the vendor's onboarding and support, because a tool your team never fully sets up delivers no value.
